request.deadline: 18-month transition and operations period, with milestones from Q3 2026 through 2027
deliverables: Not-for-profit entity established or host-organization agreement signed under preliminary board in Q3 2026
Technical transition architecture and migration plan published for community review in Q3 2026
Public usage dashboard live in Q3 2026
Board election held via on-chain voting under published rules in Q4 2026
Newly elected board formally assumes mandate by Q4 2026 / no later than end of Q1 2027
All public API traffic for mainnet, preview, and preprod served by the new stack in Q1 2027
Blockfrost source code, trademarks, domain names, and associated assets legally transferred to the governing entity in Q1 2027
Sustainability consultation and proposal published in Q2-Q3 2027
Public API operated at minimum 99% monthly uptime SLA during 2027 operational milestones
Quarterly reports published covering technical metrics and budget summary
request.recipient: Input Output / Blockfrost transition under Intersect/CDH administration; exact treasury withdrawal recipient is not stated in document.
request.what: Transition Blockfrost into a free, community-governed public good under an independent not-for-profit, including 18 months of transition and operations funding.

claims.claim: Blockfrost is described as a hosted REST interface that lets developers read from and interact with Cardano without running their own infrastructure or node.
The proposal states Blockfrost usage in the Cardano Foundation developer ecosystem survey grew from 39.3% in 2022 to 71.5% in 2025, with links to the cited survey pages.
The proposal states Blockfrost served 781k unique visitors, more than 1.84 billion API requests, almost 700 rps, and over 7 TB of API data last month.
The proposal states that in most Cardano epochs more than 50% of all transactions are submitted through Blockfrost.
The proposal says more than 100 Icebreakers have joined the decentralized Blockfrost operator effort.
The proposal states that 90% of Cardano traffic served through the Blockfrost API comes from the free tier and that the commercial model has struggled to finance this public-good operation.
The proposal commits to transferring Blockfrost source code, trademarks, domain names, and associated assets into community stewardship under a governing not-for-profit entity.
The proposal requests 9,832,979 ADA, calculated from 1,868,266 USD at 0.19 USD per ADA, for 18 months of operations and transition.
The budget allocates 7,780,347 ADA to staffing for six people, 1,894,737 ADA to operations and infrastructure, and 157,895 ADA to legal and accounting.
The proposal states that unspent post-transition infrastructure budget will be returned to the treasury and that quarterly reports will include technical data and a budget summary.

summary: The document proposes a 9,832,979 ADA treasury-funded transition of Blockfrost from a commercial service into a community-governed not-for-profit public API, with staged governance, IP transfer, service migration, dashboard reporting, and 18 months of operations.
